rules.statement: A deed of donation to a minor is not valid unless accepted by the natural guardian of the minor, and in cases involving an adulterine union, the putative father cannot accept on behalf of the minor.
rules.supporting_quote: "By deed 15373 of 13.1.1922 (P2) one Maria Alwis gifted to Kotte Muhandiramge Emaliyanu Rodrigo and Ponweera Aratchige Don Gabriel, both minor children of one Maria Perera, who does not appear to have been related to the donor Maria Alwis. ... Jusey it was who accepted the gift on P2 wherein he purported to accept on behalf of Gabriel ' a son of mine ' and on behalf of Emaliyanu ' an adopted son of mine '."
